content.title: TherML: The Thermodynamics of Machine Learning
content.abstract: In this work we offer an information-theoretic framework for representation learning that connects with a wide class of existing objectives in machine learning. We develop a formal correspondence between this work and thermodynamics and discuss its implications.
content.TL;DR: We offer a framework for representation learning that connects with a wide class of existing objectives and is analogous to thermodynamics.
